title: Results — 2026 Election
desc: Stage advances to "Tally" once voting closes
structure:
The .topbar has

Results — 2026 Election

and a .top-right holding one .btn-outline-sm with a download-arrow svg and span "Export report". No back chevron, no subnav. The .content block holds three siblings in order. 1) .certify-banner (navy-800 fill, radius 14, padding 15px 18px, margin-bottom 20px, flex gap 13): an amber 20px check-in-circle svg, then an unclassed div wrapping .cb1 "Voting closed — awaiting certification" and .cb2 "As Returning Officer, review the tally below then certify to publish results estate-wide.", then .certify-btn (amber-500, margin-left auto) reading "Certify & publish results". 2) .turnout-panel (white, navy-100 border, radius 16, padding 18, margin-bottom 20). Inside: .turnout-top (flex, space-between) with

Overall turnout

and .tv containing "318 " followed by an inline of 450 households (71%). Then .t-bar (10px navy-100 track) containing in amber. Then .phase-turnout-row (flex, gap 10) with five .ptr-item, each a .ptr-track (44px navy-100 block, bars bottom-aligned) containing at a fixed height plus a caption span: height 80% / "Phase 1 · 80%"; 65% / "Phase 2 · 65%"; 74% / "Phase 3 · 74%"; 58% / "Phase 4 · 58%"; 69% / "Phase 5 · 69%". 3) An unclassed two-column grid
with two unclassed white result cards (background white, 1px navy-100 border, radius 16, padding 16). Card 1 heading div (Poppins 13px, weight 600, margin-bottom 10) "Chairman", then two .winner-row: .w-avatar "DR" + .w-info (.wn "Dwayne Robinson", .wr "Phase 1") + .w-votes (187, 59%); and .w-avatar "SC" + (.wn "Sonia Campbell", .wr "Phase 4") + (131, 41%). Card 2 heading "Vice Chairman · 3 seats", then .winner-row "MP" / "Michelle Palmer" / "Phase 3" / 201 / 63%, and "AT" / "Andre Thompson" / "Phase 5" / 176 / 55%.
domain_needs: election.id / year = 2026 (route /governance/elections/2026/results); h1 "Results — 2026 Election"

election.current_stage = "Tally" / voting_closed (the row-label says the stage advances to "Tally" once voting closes) and election.certified_at = null, which drives the banner copy "Voting closed — awaiting certification"
election.certification_action available only to the Returning Officer role (banner text "As Returning Officer, review the tally below then certify to publish results estate-wide.")
election.publish_scope = estate-wide on certification
turnout.votes_cast = 318
turnout.eligible_households = 450 (matches the 450 eligible households stat on screen 09)
turnout.percentage = 71% (DERIVED: 318 / 450 = 70.67%, rounded to 71%; the .t-bar fill width is the same 71%)
turnout composite label "318 of 450 households (71%)" — count, denominator and rounded percentage rendered together

phase_turnout.phase_label + phase_turnout.percentage: Phase 1 80%, Phase 2 65%, Phase 3 74%, Phase 4 58%, Phase 5 69% (bar height in the .ptr-track equals the percentage; caption format "Phase N · NN%")
estate.phase_count = 5 (five .ptr-item bars; matches "all 5 phases" on screen 12)
NOTE: the five phase percentages are NOT a straight average of 71% — each is its own phase-level votes_cast / phase eligible_households, so phase eligible counts must be stored per phase
election_position.name for result cards — "Chairman", "Vice Chairman"
election_position.seat_count surfaced in the card heading only when >1: "Vice Chairman · 3 seats" (Chairman card shows no seat suffix because seat_count = 1)
result.candidate_name + result.initials — Dwayne Robinson (DR), Sonia Campbell (SC), Michelle Palmer (MP), Andre Thompson (AT)
result.candidate_phase — "Phase 1", "Phase 4", "Phase 3", "Phase 5" (phase only here, no lot number, unlike screen 10)
result.vote_count — 187, 131, 201, 176

result.vote_percentage — 59%, 41%, 63%, 55% (DERIVED). Chairman: 187+131 = 318 = total votes cast, so 187/318 = 58.8% → 59% and 131/318 = 41.2% → 41%; the two shares sum to 100%. Vice Chairman is a 3-seat race where 201/318 = 63.2% → 63% and 176/318 = 55.3% → 55%, i.e. percentage of BALLOTS CAST, not share of total votes — the shares deliberately exceed 100% when summed across a multi-seat race. Store the denominator basis explicitly.
result.sort_order — candidates ordered by vote_count descending within each position card
result.is_winner — DERIVED: top seat_count candidates by vote_count (Dwayne Robinson for Chairman; the Vice Chairman card shows only 2 of 3 seats filled in this slice)
Andre Thompson appears in results but not in the screen 10 nomination list, so results must resolve candidates independently of the visible nomination page slice
export.results_report action available from the topbar
